description: finds duplicate composite keys across object rows using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json unique fields check result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Unique Fields Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

fields.description: Fields supplied to JSON Unique Fields Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

items.description: Items supplied to JSON Unique Fields Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.
